text.action.return.completed: You cross the gangplank home; cargo, discoveries, terrain, and consequences persist.{merchant}{visitors}{development}
text.action.drink.tavern_required: Drinks are served face to face at Jomon's bar.
text.action.route.unavailable: No intermediate route service is available here.
text.action.route.resupply.exhausted: This stop's counted provisions are exhausted.
text.action.route.resupply.credit: One credit is needed for witnessed provisions.
text.action.route.resupply.used: {node} loads one dry grain lot for one credit.
text.action.route.trade.unavailable: {node} seeks {commodity}, which Jomon does not carry.
text.action.route.trade.used: {node} takes one {commodity} lot; Jomon gains two credit.
text.action.route.sound.complete: Every connected leg is already charted.
text.action.route.invalid: That route-stop work is not available.
text.action.interact.vertical_blocked: The {threat} holds the vertical opening; confront it across the level first.
text.action.interact.vertical_used: You use the {link}; nearby levels remain spatially aligned.{sanctum}{structure}{slow}{marked}
text.action.interact.vertical.slow: Lower-limb injury or heavy armour makes the climb slow.
text.action.interact.vertical.marked: Height reveals and marks a named treasure lead.
text.action.objective.load_full: The load exceeds bulk or clear pack cells.
text.action.objective.secured: You secure two {commodity}; valuables and sound rise.
text.action.objective.lost_ground: The load is empty, but the lost {commodity} remains at {x},{y}, level {z}; recover it with I.
text.action.objective.lost_enemy: The load is empty; {carrier} still carries the physical {commodity}.
text.intent.item.red_clay: bound by the fired local compact
text.intent.item.wreck_light: turns from the hard prism light
text.intent.item.signal_mirror: disrupted by the signal mirror; recovers its sightline
text.intent.item.lantern: follows controlled light away from the route
text.action.weather.clear: The weather opens; long sightlines return.
text.action.weather.hard_rain: Hard rain slows exposed travel and feeds low water.
text.action.weather.coast_squall: A coast squall salts bowstrings and shortens the flats' sightlines.
text.action.weather.salt_wind: The salt wind clears long coastal sightlines.
text.action.weather.forest_rain: Forest rain muffles trails while making bow grips treacherous.
text.action.weather.crosswind: A crosswind carries smoke and sound between Greenwold clearings.
text.action.weather.ridge_gust: A ridge gust exposes high shooters and makes scree footing uncertain.
text.action.process.greywash.1: White lines advance over the flats: the working tide has turned.
text.action.process.greywash.2: The tide covers the low wreck road; the dune road and chain walk remain.
text.action.process.greywash.2_held: The dogged tide chain keeps the marked low wreck road exposed.
text.action.process.greywash.3: The tide chain goes taut; late recovery now requires the upper windlass.
text.action.process.greenwold.1: Birds lift downwind: burn smoke has begun crossing the southern clearing.
text.action.process.greenwold.2: The shifting wind carries smoke into the raised burnworks and level above.
text.action.process.greenwold.2_safe: The burn stops short of the medicine route; its smoke rises clear.
text.action.process.greenwold.3: The medicine coppice is singed; the request changes from prevention to salvage.
text.action.process.whitecairn.1: Loose limestone ticks down the switchback: the quarry face is moving.
text.action.process.whitecairn.2: Rockfall covers the direct quarry stair; the sink loop remains open.
text.action.process.whitecairn.2_safe: The braced face holds; the direct quarry stair remains legible.
text.action.process.whitecairn.3: The real quarry bell answers the false one; the lower braces begin to fail.
text.action.process.hearthford: The mill bell marks rising water; safe working time is visibly narrowing.
text.action.process.objective_changed: {process} changes the worksite; local demand worsens.
text.action.process.escalation: High pressure wakes {threat}; valuables and noise made it legible.
text.action.status.coalheart.consequence: wetness and exposed travel become dangerous
text.action.status.flood_mark.consequence: movement may take another action; rest or wait it out
text.action.status.winter_bead.consequence: ranged reach shortens until four actions or warm shelter
text.action.sound.echo_bead: The echo bead answers: danger stirs on level {level}.
text.combat.damage.river_glass_ward: The river-glass ward breaks instead of its bearer.
text.action.vehicle.separated: You are separated from the vehicle; it remains at its last position.
text.action.pressure.increased: Pressure becomes {band}: alert distance and pursuit increase.
text.action.interact.tavern_draw.busy: Finish the other active tavern game before opening Tavern Draw.
text.action.interact.tavern_draw.ready: The draw-poker cards and counted stakes are ready.
text.action.interact.quay_bones.busy: Finish the other active tavern game before opening Quay Bones.
text.action.interact.quay_bones.ready: {bartender}'s two dice and counted challenge purse are ready.
text.action.depart.started.tug: You moor the tug and step ashore into {region}; the region extends beyond the viewport.
text.action.depart.started.gangplank: You cross Jomon's gangplank into {region}; the region extends beyond the viewport.
text.action.interact.vertical.combat.down: You use the ladder down under voyage pressure.
text.action.interact.vertical.combat.up: You use the stair up under voyage pressure.
text.action.interact.vertical.down: You use Jomon's ladder down between aligned decks.
text.action.interact.vertical.up: You use Jomon's stair up between aligned decks.
text.combat.intent.skill.weapon_bind: marked aim spoiled by a blade bind
text.combat.intent.skill.line_intercept: entangled by a trained intercept; loses a turn
